create_policy_subclass: create a subclass of Policy that implements _parse_obs and get_action for a new environment
use_assert_fully_parsed_decorator: use the assert_fully_parsed decorator to validate an observation parsing function returns complete data
compute_move_action: compute a scaled action vector to move from one xyz position to another using the move function
implement_parse_obs: implement the _parse_obs static method to extract relevant fields from an observation array into a dict
implement_get_action: implement the get_action method to return a 4-element action array from an observation
